purpose: Add w2dp-tb-r09-20261108, w3dp-tb-r08-20261108 and w3dp-tb-r09-20261108 so W2/thingsboard reaches three valid repetitions (r3@o34, r6@o63, r9) and W3/thingsboard reaches three (r3@o27, r8, r9), giving a balanced 12x3 matrix. No cell gains a fourth valid repetition.
why: W2/thingsboard stands at 2 valid reps and W3/thingsboard at 1. Every pre-registered ID for both cells is spent, and what spent them was host faults rather than platform results: the early repetitions died on pre-traffic gates, o64 was burned by a capture port its own aborted predecessor still held, and on 2026-11-18 a flaky load-host SSH path consumed o65, o66 and o67 in three consecutive launches that never sent a single message (workload_launch_attempted false). Those remain burned and are never retried. These three IDs are new: one closes W2, two close W3. Each is a repetition of an already-qualified fixed point, so the design stays balanced at three valid reps per cell.
